_comment: 课程页: 状态分段/类型筛选/搜索框/任务行渲染（自恢复: 若停在课程库子标签先切回任务列表）
expression: async () => { const mytab = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /^(我的任务|任务)$/.test(b.innerText.trim())); if (mytab) { mytab.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); } const inp = document.querySelector('input[type=search]'); return { readyState: document.readyState, hash: location.hash, brand: document.querySelector('.app-shell h1')?.innerText || '', search: !!inp, segs: document.querySelectorAll('button').length, rows: document.querySelectorAll('main a, main [class*=card], main li').length }; }
